title: Globex — Security Questionnaire Response Summary
body: Summary of Acme's response to Globex's June 2026 security questionnaire: SOC 2 Type II report provided (current, renewed annually), data encrypted at rest (AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2+), data residency confirmed as US-only per Globex's requirement, SSO/SAML supported, and a documented incident-response process with a 24-hour customer notification SLA for confirmed breaches. Globex's security team accepted all responses with no follow-up questions. Full questionnaire and evidence packet available in the legal/security shared drive.
